parsed.name: 罗德与施瓦茨测试仪器
parsed.description: 这是一类支持 VISA/SCPI 远程控制的罗德与施瓦茨电子测试仪器，可通过 TCP/IP 等接口接入实验室自动化系统。常见用途包括远程参数设置、触发测量、读取波形或测量结果，以及进行自动化测试与数据采集。
parsed.description_en: This refers to a Rohde & Schwarz electronic test instrument that supports remote control through VISA/SCPI, typically connected over interfaces such as TCP/IP. In laboratories, such instruments are used for automated setup, triggering measurements, reading waveforms or measurement results, and collecting data in test workflows.

actions.description: 关闭与仪器的 VISA 通信会话。
actions.description_en: Close the VISA communication session to the instrument.

actions.description: 打开与指定资源地址仪器的 VISA 通信会话。
actions.description_en: Open a VISA communication session to the instrument at the specified resource address.

actions.description: 向仪器发送 SCPI 查询并读取返回结果。
actions.description_en: Send an SCPI query to the instrument and read back the response.

actions.description: 读取仪器返回的原始字节或二进制数据。
actions.description_en: Read raw byte or binary data returned by the instrument.

actions.description: 列出当前系统中可访问的 VISA 仪器资源。
actions.description_en: List the VISA instrument resources currently accessible on the system.

actions.description: 设置仪器通信会话的超时时间。
actions.description_en: Set the timeout for the instrument communication session.

actions.description: 向仪器发送 SCPI 命令。
actions.description_en: Send an SCPI command to the instrument.

actions.description: 向仪器发送原始字节或二进制数据。
actions.description_en: Send raw byte or binary data to the instrument.
